question: DTS subwoofer channel not heard on the soundbar
chain: the DTS fixture contains an LFE channel, measured by decoding the source elementary stream to six discrete channels
the helper emitted 1125 valid bursts whose carried frames are byte identical to that source
decoding the frames recovered from the helper output yields the same LFE at the same level
therefore what the core transmits contains the LFE channel
conclusion: The omission is downstream of the core, in the soundbar DTS handling. AC-3 LFE was audible on the same device in entry 619, so this is DTS specific to that decoder.
not_established: Why the soundbar drops it. Bass management, DTS Virtual:X processing and LFE gain conventions are all plausible and none is testable from here.
note: DTS stores LFE below the other channels, measured here at about 7.2 dB down before any decoder LFE gain, which is normal and not evidence of loss.
